ch.n: BLT Global Brands acts as a strategic master partner and operating force across European markets. We bridge the gap between world-class brand heritage and neighbourhood-level execution through agile infrastructure, robust supply chain logistics, and dedicated local marketing support. Our core commitment is to bring the most beloved brands to neighbourhoods worldwide while maintaining high ethical standards and improving the quality of life for our communities, customers, and employees.
